record.question: In Parkland formula for: Ringer's Lactate = ?
record.explanation: Answer C: 4 mL × kg × % TBSA. The classic Parkland formula estimates 24-hour burn resuscitation volume as 4 mL × body weight (kg) × %TBSA, with half given in the first 8 hours from burn time. Source/context note: Modern burn guidelines may start with lower volumes and titrate to response; this is the classic formula the item asks for. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK482198/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
